content: Degisoggu, a-ular, be bela ibmar-isgana-imaked mimarsun, bela emar-yardaked, wagar-darbodaed, aimargi-nobgued, degi, bela gakansaar-aimargi-sunmaked, be obelomarsun.
Mimmigan-emisgwa-aidenonikidyob bemar nunis-burbaled-nuedbina be sogmar. We-nunis Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba gued. Adi, agi be gatik nasgumai be-abonolesmaladgi gumalagar.
Ar bemar bato Bab-Dummad-dulemar-sabed begi na be itosmalad.
Jesucristo, akwa-nued-neg-ganikidyobidid
Degisoggu, Jesucristo-akwa-dulayobidse be dagmar. Dulemardi isdar a-akwa daksamalad. Bab-Dummaddi na susagusad, degine, we-akwa, akwa-garged-sunnadid, akwa-nuedid.

Amba deyob be akwa-duladyob gumarmogad. A-akwa-duladgi Babse-goled-neg-burbaled-soblegedga be gumalad. Deyobi, be dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-swilidikidga be gumalad, adi, Bab-Dummadga Babga-ibmar-ukleged-burbaled-nuegan be Cristo-nuggi ukmalagar.
A-ulale, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi, Cristo-akwa-nuedye-sognaidgi sognaibalid:

content.text: “¡Be dakmala! Ani an Sión-yalagi akwa-bur-nued-sulealed, negsailaga mesisad.
Ar dule agi bensulile, suli-suli itogosulid.”

content: Isaías 28:16
Ar a-akwa-Jesucristoʼgi be bensurmarsoggu, bemargardi, we-Cristo, ibmar-sunsogedid. Ar dulemar-egi-benmaladgardi, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi Cristoʼgi-sognaidba gunonikid:
Salmo 118:22
Degine, Bab-Dummad-Gardagi sognaibalid:
Isaías 8:14-15 Ar ade, uaya surmarsoggu, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburbagi yoledimarsunnad, ar ade, bato iduar deyob amarga igar-megisad.
Bab-Dummad-e-dulamar

Bab-Dummad deyob be-susmalad, adi, Bab-Dummad-ibmar-nued-imakedgi be dulemar-baiganga sunmakmalagar, sogmalagar, igi bemar negsichidgi-gudigu, Bab-Dummad be-onosmala, e-neg-meegwad-nuedse be-searmala.
Bemar iduardi, Bab-Dummadgadsurmalanad, emigindi, Bab-Dummadgadga be gunonimalad. Ar iduardi, Bab-Dummad wile be-daksasurmalanad, emigindi, Bab-Dummad wile bemar-daknonikisunnad.
Dummagan-urbalikwaa be nanamar

Gwenadgan-sabesarmalad, an bemargi wilemar, we-napneg bemar-negsursoggu, we-napneggi be sikwas gudimarsoggu, mer be-san-ibmar-isganabina-soged be imakmar. Ar we-ibmar-isgana anmar-burba-nued-ebo urwenaid.

Gwenadgan, bemar dule-Bab-Dummad-wissurmalad-abargi nued-nanadii be imakmar. Adi, gakansaar-dule-isganaye-begi-sunmakdimaladi be ibmar-nuegan-imakedbali, a-dulemar, Bab-Dummad-bela-dulemarga-igar-nabodanikid-ibagi, Bab-Dummad-nug odummomalagar.
Bab-Dummad-abemaidba bemar bela dule-dummagan-nugsalesmalad-urbaligwa be nanamar. Rey, bur-dummadsoggu, a-urbaligwa be nanamar.
Dummagan-negdakmamaid-urbaligwa be nanamar. Ar wemar, rey-nuggi dule-ibmar-isgana-imakmalad-sabsur-odurdakega barmilearmalad, degi, dule-ibmar-nuegan-imakmalad-e-nug-ogannomalaga barmilearmalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad weyob abemaid: Be ibmar-nued-imakedba, dule-ibmar-wissurmalad, isdar-begi-sunmakmalad, begi geg ibmar-soge gumalagar.
Ar bemar be-binsaedba be nanamar. Melle we-be-deyob-nanaedi, ibmar-isgana-imakega be ebumar. Bemar Bab-Dummad-mai-napiragwadsunnadsoggu, deyob na be san oyomar.
Bela dulemargi binsaed-nikaa be damar. Na be gwenadgan sabgumar, Bab-Dummad-dobekwaa be nanamar. Reygi binsaed-nikaa be damar.
Maiga-gudimalad igi-e-dummagangi daoe
Bemar maiga-gudidimalad, be-dummadgi bela nue-binsaed-nikaa be nanamar. Dummagan-nuegan-daedginbi mer be deyob nanamalo. Amba dummagan-ichakwa-daedgi be binsaed-nikaa dabaloed.
Dulemar-Bab-Dummadba-daedba-sabsur-wiledimaladgi Bab-Dummad nued binsadaed. Ar we-dulemala ibmar-oakalossulidba wiledimalad.
Ar be-isgudiid-ular dulemar sabsur-be-odurdaker, ¿ar ibi-nued egi be amiosunna, ar bede isgudiid? Ar ibmar-nued-imaked-ular, dulemar sabsur-be-odurdakerdi, wedi Bab-Dummad yeer be-dakdo.
Ar Bab-Dummad a-ular anmarse gochad. Ar Cristo amba deyob anmar-anar wilesmogad, anmarga e-wilub na oyosad, adi, anmar eba daegar.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi we-Cristoʼgi sognaid:
Isaías 53:9

Cristoʼgi dulemar isdar sunmaknanaigusgua, edi gwen dulemargi isdar sunmaksasulid. Dulemar e-wionanai-gusgua, edi gwen dulemar-abin-sogsasulid, anse be oitolemogoye. Ar deyob wilenaigusgua, Cristo bela ega igar-nudakega, Bab-Dummad-igar-inniki-naboged-maidga e-igar na uksagusad.

Ar e-sunnad nakrusgi-bioklenai-gusgua, anmar-isgued e-sangi sesagusad, adi, anmar isguedga burgwar gudiguega, igar-innikigwadginbi nanadii guegar. We-Cristo-bemar-anar-naibigusadgi be nugunonimarsunnad.
Ar bemar sibad-wawaad-yoggus-gudigusmaladyob gudigusanad. Emigindi, igi-sibad-wawaad e-dule-edarbedse gannar noniki, deyob be gannar Cristo-be-san-burba-akwemaidse nonimarsunnad.
